events.title: September's Dev Update
events.summary: NewsThis month's updates have been focused around preparing the demo for Steam Next Fest! With the press preview starting on the 8th of October, just a few days away, I'll actually be releasing the demo sooner than expected. Both Windows and Linux/Steam Deck builds will be available, so be sure to give it a try and join our Discord to share your feedback! If you enjoy your demo experience (and even if you don't), I'd appreciate it if you took the time to leave a review on the Demo's Steam store

events.title: August's Monthly Dev Updates
events.summary: We are hard at work getting both the Slip Angle Demo ready and continuing the larger effort of launching the game in Early Access! If you're interested in following the game's development more closely, please consider joining our Discord server or adding the game to your Wishlist so you get notified once it's available.
